name: Space Ambassador Volunteer (Space Foundation Discovery Center)
what_you_do: Help visitors at a space science museum. Jobs include gallery guide work, helping in a Mars robot lab, and talks on a Science On a Sphere display. You can also help in a 3D printing lab or the drone zone.
who_can_apply: Anyone at least 14 years old. A background check is needed if you are 18 or older.
duration: At least two shifts a month, Tuesday through Saturday
deadline_text: The page says it is still taking applications. The museum plans to reopen in January 2027.
how_to_apply: Use the Apply Now link on the page. Call 719-319-3678 or email volunteer@spacefoundation.org with questions.
notes: You can apply while the museum is closed. The museum plans to reopen in January 2027.
